prompt: A single blank rubber-stamp ink impression, scanned flat, to be used as a texture mask in a web interface. It is the print a worn rectangular rubber stamp leaves when pressed onto paper: a solid filled rectangle of ink that fills almost the whole frame edge to edge with only a small even margin, with one thin knocked-out (unprinted) frame line running parallel to the edge just inside it. The ink coverage is uneven the way real hand stamping is: dense and solid in most areas, lighter and broken where the stamp pressed less, fine pinhole speckle and paper-fibre gaps scattered through the fill, a few larger dry patches near one corner, slightly ragged, worn outer edges and softened corners. Solid pure black ink only, on a fully transparent background; no paper, no shadow, no grey, no colour. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, symbols, logos or emblems anywhere: the inside of the stamp is a blank field of ink. Straight on, not rotated, no perspective.
